waive.TypeOK: Shape check only: no behaviour change breaks it without also breaking a property above it.

mutations.name: keep-held-wait-on-new-user-run
mutations.why: sync() no longer ends a held wait when the user starts a new run (#judge's `fact.running && !fact.lastRun` clause covers only the probe): flush later sends retry into the user's live run.

mutations.name: probe-ignores-session-change
mutations.why: #verifyNetwork's continuation stops comparing the session file and `touched` count: a session or branch change during the probe still ends in a held wait and a retry.

mutations.name: marker-ignores-wait
mutations.why: deriveMarkers stops giving awaitingConnection the `network` reason: a crash during the wait no longer retries.
mutations.search: IF awaiting[ct] THEN "network" ELSE IF stopped[ct] THEN "none"
mutations.replace: IF FALSE THEN "network" ELSE IF stopped[ct] THEN "none"

mutations.name: fire-hold-without-sync
mutations.why: F1 as it was: #fire hands the attempt to the connection wait offline and returns without sync(), so the marker file is not rewritten while the wait holds.
mutations.search: /\ pc' = "s_watch" /\ ct' = t /\ rp' = rp        \* the sync() after #hold in #fire

mutations.name: held-wait-ignores-session-change
mutations.why: F4 as it was: #judge stops ending a held wait when `touched` or the session file moved (#movedSince), so flush retries the failed turn into the session the tab shows now.

mutations.name: fire-keeps-armed-row-on-hold
mutations.why: #fire stops releasing the scheduled retry before it hands the attempt to the connection wait: the tab shows a wait and a scheduled retry at once.

mutations.name: unshared-probe
mutations.why: verify() starts a probe for every ask instead of sharing the one in flight for the host.

mutations.name: offline-when-either-fails
mutations.why: #reachable needs both asks to answer (`every` instead of `includes(true)`): a mistyped provider URL alone takes the state offline.

mutations.name: remove-fairness-wait
mutations.why: Nothing forces the runtime to run what is queued: a held wait may stay forever.

mutations.name: remove-fairness-probe
mutations.why: Nothing forces the probe to answer: a probe row may stay forever.

mutations.name: flush-leaves-wait-row
mutations.why: flush() runs the continuation but forgets setAwaitingConnection(false): the wait row never goes.
mutations.search: /\ awaiting' = [t \in Tabs |-> IF waiting[t] THEN FALSE ELSE awaiting[t]]

mutations.name: probe-answer-lost
mutations.why: The probe's answer never reaches the waiting tab (the .then is never called): the probe row stays.
mutations.search: IN /\ vRes' = vRes \cup {<<w[1], w[2], result>> : w \in vW}
